response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, entry_count - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) AS diff FROM per_race WHERE entry_count > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
